sentences.text: Asio pythiotus was an owl that belonged to the genus Asio.
The species Asio pythiotus was newly described by Zelenkov.
The study that introduced the taxon concentrated on larger owls from the Lower Pleistocene of Crimea.
The genus Asio is placed within the family Strigidae, the true owls.
The fossil specimen dates to the Pleistocene epoch and was recovered in Crimea.
Members of the genus Asio are known from the Tortonian to the Holocene, spanning between 11.63 and 0 million years ago.
